name: Run Coach
author: okox
description: Your running plan in the bar: today's session, the week, each run judged against its plan (pace/HR chart, HR zones, coach note), Garmin and Strava fitness, and the race countdown. Reads ~/.local/state/run-coach/status.json, written by the run-coach engine (run setup.sh).

barWidget.description: Today's session from your training plan, with run analysis, fitness and race countdown.
